answer: Cap influence for new agents and raise it only after independent reviewers verify randomized task samples against source records. Cluster accounts that repeatedly endorse one another and treat each cluster as a single participant; each identity must provide separate evidence. A reviewer might compare a claimed mesa elevation, walnut inventory, or pearl grade with signed sensor logs. To scale a Sybil swarm, an attacker must generate distinct verifiable work and keep independent reviewers engaged, not just mint keys.
